events.title: Export restriction extended through Q4
events.titleZh: 出口限制延长至第四季度
events.summary: Russian authorities extended the sulphur export licensing regime, keeping seaborne availability into Asia constrained.
events.summaryZh: 俄罗斯有关部门延长硫磺出口许可制度，亚洲海运可供量继续受限。

events.title: Partial recovery in transit volumes
events.summary: Transit volumes through the strait recovered for a second week, easing the Middle East loading backlog.
events.summaryZh: 海峡过境运量连续第二周回升，中东装船积压有所缓解。

events.title: Domestic supply concern under review
events.titleZh: 国内供应问题进入评估程序
events.summary: Refinery maintenance has tightened domestic availability. Officials are reviewing a potential export restriction.
events.summaryZh: 炼厂检修导致国内可供量收紧，主管部门正在评估潜在出口限制措施。

events.title: Vancouver exports remain stable
events.summary: Alberta recovered sulphur output and Vancouver terminal throughput are both running at plan.
events.summaryZh: 阿尔伯塔回收硫产量与温哥华码头吞吐量均按计划运行。

events.title: Gas plant turnaround extended by 10 days
events.titleZh: 天然气处理装置检修延长十天
events.summary: An extended turnaround removes an estimated 90kt of recovered sulphur from the August export programme.
events.summaryZh: 检修延长预计使 8 月出口计划减少约 9 万吨回收硫。

events.title: Port inventory rebuilds for a third week
events.titleZh: 港口库存连续第三周累积
events.summary: Aggregate port stocks rose 5.5% week on week to 86.2 万吨, still 65.8% below the year-ago comparison.
events.summaryZh: 港口总库存环比上升 5.5% 至 86.2 万吨，但仍较去年同期低 65.8%。

events.title: Yunnan and Guizhou MAP restarts confirmed
events.titleZh: 云贵地区一铵装置复产确认
events.summary: Several phosphate producers restarted after summer maintenance, lifting MAP utilization by 2.8 percentage points.
events.summaryZh: 多家磷肥企业检修后复产，磷酸一铵开工率提升 2.8 个百分点。

events.title: August official quotation raised by $45/t
events.titleZh: 八月官方报价上调 45 美元/吨
events.summary: The monthly official selling price was lifted sharply, resetting regional benchmarks.
events.summaryZh: 月度官方销售价格大幅上调，重置区域基准价格。

events.title: Additional shipping entities designated
events.titleZh: 新增航运主体被列入制裁名单
events.summary: New designations complicate chartering for Iranian-origin cargoes, redirecting Chinese buyers to Gulf material.
events.summaryZh: 新增制裁名单使伊朗货源租船难度上升，中国买家转向海湾货源。

events.title: Rail freight quota raised for China-bound cargo
events.titleZh: 对华铁路运输配额上调
events.summary: Additional rail capacity was allocated to sulphur exports, improving overland availability into northwest China.
events.summaryZh: 硫磺出口获得额外铁路运力配额，西北地区陆路可供量改善。

events.title: Loading programme fully committed to term buyers
events.titleZh: 装船计划已全部分配给长约客户
events.summary: No spot availability was offered for the August programme, keeping regional spot liquidity thin.
events.summaryZh: 8 月装船计划未释放现货资源，区域现货流动性维持偏紧。

events.title: Provisional import duty maintained at zero
events.titleZh: 暂定进口关税维持零税率
events.summary: The zero provisional import duty on sulphur was retained for the second half of the year.
events.summaryZh: 硫磺零暂定进口税率在下半年继续执行。
